definitions.explanation: The professional level of sumo wrestling in Japan, organized by the Japan Sumo Association. Features six annual tournaments (honbasho) held in Tokyo, Osaka, Nagoya, and Fukuoka.

examples.english: I'm going to watch professional sumo.

examples.japanese: {大相撲|おおずもう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{力士|りきし}→力士：10115_rikishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: I met a professional sumo wrestler.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大相撲|おおずもう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大好|だいす}き→大好き：02911_daisuki⟧で、⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{見|み}ている→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather loves professional sumo and watches it on TV every day.

notes:
{大相撲|おおずもう} refers specifically to professional sumo wrestling organized by the {日本相撲協会|にほんすもうきょうかい} (Japan Sumo Association), as distinguished from amateur sumo.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大相撲|おおずもう}{本場所|ほんばしょ}: grand sumo tournament
- {大相撲|おおずもう}⟦{中継|ちゅうけい}→中継：11306_chuukei⟧: sumo broadcast
- {大相撲|おおずもう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to watch sumo
- {大相撲|おおずもう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{力士|りきし}→力士：10115_rikishi⟧: professional sumo wrestler

TOURNAMENTS:
Six {本場所|ほんばしょ} per year: three in ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧ (⟦{両国|りょうごく}→両国：28395_ryougoku⟧⟦{国技館|こくぎかん}→国技館：28938_kokugikan⟧), and one each in ⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧, ⟦{名古屋|なごや}→名古屋：19405_nagoya⟧, and ⟦{福岡|ふくおか}→福岡：30729_fukuoka⟧.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{相撲|すもう}→相撲：00390_sumou⟧: sumo in general
- {角界|かくかい}: the sumo world (industry term)
- ⟦{横綱|よこづな}→横綱：14957_yokozuna⟧: grand champion (highest rank)
